_**User (2026-04-20 19:25:34Z)**_

If you do a git status (current branch improve-package-setup), you'll notice that in all .py files in @aluminium/ that use scikit-learn metrics function metrics.mean_squared_error with argument squared=False, I have replaced that line with using the function metrics.root_mean_squared_error without that parameter and argument. This is because the original code in 2024 used scikit-learn 1.2 and now we're at scikit-learn version 1.8. Meanwhile, scikit-learn 1.4 deprecated mean_squared_error(..., squared=False) and added root_mean_squared_error(...). The squared parameter was removed from mean_squared_error in version 1.6. What I would ask you to do now is to scan all .py files in the remaining examples @2d_mos2/, @benzene/ml_model/, and @molybdenium/ml_model/ for this usage and replace the respective line with the modern version. I'll then check with git diff on each example folder whether you've done that correctly.
